training: Pinned UD Czech train only, ASCII26 wordless quadgrams, same normalization and scoring as public builder; selected exact training sentences and train-document whole-excerpt matches excluded.
selection: First six eligible dev document excerpts in corpus order, distinct document IDs, excluding prior six IDs; longest sentence-prefix concatenate until required length then truncate. Candidate documents rejected on exact selected sentence overlap or whole-excerpt occurrence in any train document. Selection and masks saved before any solver invocation.
mask_algorithm: For each seeded RNG, choose 13 runs independently with randint(2,5); select from a shuffled list of valid starts such that runs neither overlap nor touch; choose 17 shuffled unused singleton positions disjoint from all runs. Each whole run collapses to one sentinel26; each singleton becomes sentinel26. Retain original coordinates and lengths in separate gold.
sentinel_semantics: UNKNOWN gap marker, never a word-space or certified one-cipher-unit; core renders sentinel as space solely for scoring. Unknown run cardinalities withheld from inference.
negative_selection: First three positive samples, fixed seed +200000; shuffle only observed cipher symbols while preserving all gap-marker locations and all observed symbol frequencies.
solver_seeds: Per-sample permutation seed; negative seeds corresponding base seed+200000
baseline: Train-only letter frequencies ranked against cipher observed counts, ignoring sentinel; grade only original known positions; ties numerical ascending.
claim_limits: Three negatives carry no historical probability/significance
Code input evidence only; no OS attestation or claim that agent never saw synthetic gold
